_meta.description: Own-written constitution questionnaire (SOP D6): nine types, 1–5 frequency scale. Scoring rule of the national standard (ZYYXH/T157-2009), wording is ours. Draft awaiting practitioner review.
_meta.scoring: converted = (raw - n) / (4 n) * 100 over the answered items of a type; reverse items score 6 - answer

prompt.en: Thinking of the past year, how often does each of these happen?
prompt.zh-Hant: 回想最近一年，下面的情形出現得有多頻繁？

description.en: Generally balanced: good energy, sleep and digestion, and a good ability to adapt to the environment and the seasons.
description.zh-Hant: 整體平衡、精力與睡眠、消化都不錯，適應環境與季節變化的能力好。

text.en: I have plenty of energy and rarely feel tired
text.zh-Hant: 精力充沛，不容易覺得疲倦

text.en: I sleep well and wake up refreshed
text.zh-Hant: 睡得好，醒來精神不錯

text.en: My appetite is normal and I rarely feel bloated after eating
text.zh-Hant: 胃口正常，吃了不容易脹或不舒服

text.en: I often feel unwell somewhere in my body
text.zh-Hant: 身體常有這裡那裡不舒服的感覺

text.en: I adapt quickly when the weather or surroundings change
text.zh-Hant: 天氣或環境改變時，我很快就能適應

description.en: Tires easily, short of breath, low tolerance for exertion, a quiet voice, and more prone to colds and sweating without effort.
description.zh-Hant: 容易疲倦、氣短、不耐勞累，說話聲音偏低，較容易感冒或出虛汗。

text.en: I get short of breath or palpitations with slight exertion
text.zh-Hant: 稍微活動就覺得喘或心悸

text.en: I feel low in energy all day and do not feel like talking
text.zh-Hant: 整天沒什麼精神，不太想說話

text.en: I catch colds more easily than other people
text.zh-Hant: 比別人容易感冒

text.en: I sweat without being hot, and more so after activity
text.zh-Hant: 沒有特別熱也會出汗，活動後更明顯

description.en: Feels the cold, has cold hands and feet, prefers warm food and drink, and is upset or loose-stooled after cold food.
description.zh-Hant: 怕冷、手腳冰涼，喜歡熱的飲食，吃涼的容易不舒服或腹瀉。

text.en: My hands and feet are colder than other people's
text.zh-Hant: 我的手腳比別人冰冷

text.en: Cold food or drink easily upsets me
text.zh-Hant: 吃或喝冰冷的東西容易不舒服

text.en: I feel the cold badly in winter and stay cold even in many layers
text.zh-Hant: 冬天特別怕冷，穿很多還是不暖

text.en: I tend to have loose stools, especially after cold food
text.zh-Hant: 容易腹瀉或大便偏稀，尤其吃了涼的之後

description.en: Dry and warm: hot palms and soles, dry mouth and throat, dry skin or eyes, light sleep and dry stools.
description.zh-Hant: 偏燥偏熱：手心腳心發熱、口乾咽燥、皮膚或眼睛乾澀，睡眠較淺，大便偏乾。

text.en: My palms or soles often feel hot
text.zh-Hant: 手心或腳心常覺得發熱

text.en: My mouth and throat are dry and I like to drink water
text.zh-Hant: 嘴巴和喉嚨乾，喜歡喝水

text.en: My skin or eyes tend to be dry
text.zh-Hant: 皮膚或眼睛偏乾澀

text.en: I tend to be constipated or have dry, hard stools
text.zh-Hant: 容易便秘，或大便偏乾硬

description.en: Heavy and sticky: a soft, full abdomen, oily skin, plenty of phlegm and a thicker tongue coating.
description.zh-Hant: 身體偏沉重、黏膩，腹部鬆軟肥滿，容易出油，痰多，舌苔偏厚。

text.en: My body feels heavy and not clear
text.zh-Hant: 覺得身體沉重、不清爽

text.en: My abdomen is full and soft
text.zh-Hant: 腹部肥滿鬆軟

text.en: My face or scalp gets oily easily
text.zh-Hant: 臉或頭皮容易出油

text.en: I have a lot of phlegm and often feel it in my throat
text.zh-Hant: 痰多，常覺得喉嚨有痰

description.en: Damp and hot: an oily face prone to spots, a bitter taste or bad breath, sticky stools, darker urine and a feeling of stuffy heat.
description.zh-Hant: 偏濕又偏熱：臉部油膩易長痘，口苦或口臭，大便黏滯不爽，小便偏黃，身體悶熱。

text.en: My face is oily or breaks out in spots easily
text.zh-Hant: 臉上容易油膩或長痘痘

text.en: I have a bitter taste or bad breath
text.zh-Hant: 口苦，或嘴裡有異味

text.en: My stools are sticky and incomplete, or my urine is dark
text.zh-Hant: 大便黏滯不爽，或小便偏黃

text.en: My body often feels stuffy and hot
text.zh-Hant: 身體常有悶熱感

description.en: Blood moves less freely: a duller complexion, easy bruising or spots, fixed stabbing pains and darker lips.
description.zh-Hant: 血行偏不暢：膚色偏暗、容易有瘀青或色斑，固定位置的刺痛，嘴唇偏暗。

text.en: I bruise easily
text.zh-Hant: 皮膚容易出現瘀青

text.en: My complexion is dull, or I have dark spots on my face
text.zh-Hant: 臉色偏暗，或臉上有色斑

text.en: I have stabbing pain in a fixed place
text.zh-Hant: 身上有固定位置的刺痛

text.en: My lips are a darker colour
text.zh-Hant: 嘴唇顏色偏暗

description.en: Mood tends to be low or tense, with frequent sighing, a tight chest or flanks, and sleep easily disturbed by worry.
description.zh-Hant: 情緒偏悶、容易緊張或憂慮，常嘆氣，胸脅脹悶，睡眠容易受情緒影響。

text.en: I often feel down or low in mood
text.zh-Hant: 常覺得悶悶不樂、情緒低落

text.en: I get tense, anxious or sensitive easily
text.zh-Hant: 容易緊張、焦慮或多愁善感

text.en: I sigh often, with a tight chest or flanks
text.zh-Hant: 常嘆氣，胸口或兩脅脹悶

text.en: My sleep is unsettled when something is on my mind
text.zh-Hant: 遇到事情就睡不安穩

description.en: Allergy-prone (pollen, dust mites, foods, medicines), flaring with the seasons, with a sensitive nose and skin.
description.zh-Hant: 容易過敏（花粉、塵蟎、食物、藥物），換季時容易發作，鼻、皮膚較敏感。

text.en: I am allergic to pollen, dust mites, foods or medicines
text.zh-Hant: 容易對花粉、塵蟎、食物或藥物過敏

text.en: I often sneeze, have a runny or blocked nose without a cold
text.zh-Hant: 沒有感冒也常打噴嚏、流鼻水或鼻塞

text.en: My skin gets rashes easily, or shows red marks after scratching
text.zh-Hant: 皮膚容易起疹子，或抓過後出現紅痕

text.en: Symptoms flare with a change of season or contact with certain things
text.zh-Hant: 換季或接觸某些東西時容易發作
